86:     diagnostic.code === 'DECIDER_RATE_LIMITED' ||
87:     diagnostic.code === 'DECIDER_UNREACHABLE' ||
88:     diagnostic.code === 'DECIDER_TIMEOUT' ||
89:     (diagnostic.status !== undefined && diagnostic.status >= 500);

91:     request,
92:     diagnostic.code === 'DECIDER_UNAVAILABLE'

95:     diagnostic.message,
96:     resumable,

98:       provenance,
99:       ...(diagnostic.code ? { code: diagnostic.code } : {}),
